lyrics:
[Intro: dreamy guitar chords, soft synth, wordless hum]
Ooh, ooh

[Verse 1: light high tenor, melodic, half mumbled]
You get by on a glass of water and a window
I forget you for a week, you only lean in closer
Every time I'm leaving, every time I'm gone
You put out a new leaf like nothing's wrong

[Chorus: both voices, soft beat, wide and warm]
You're a houseplant
Growing toward me
I don't deserve the way you stay
You're a houseplant
Still in the morning
I left you in the dark
And you grew anyway

[Verse 2: warbling baritone, slower phrasing]
I'm bad at this, I lose the things I hold
Too much or not enough is all I know
But you keep on, you keep on
Green in a grey apartment
Green in a grey apartment

[Chorus: both voices, soft beat, wide and warm]
You're a houseplant
Growing toward me
I don't deserve the way you stay
You're a houseplant
Still in the morning
I left you in the dark
And you grew anyway

[Bridge: beat drops, high voice alone with guitar]
I'll move you to the window
I'll learn your name
I'll be here in the morning
I'll try to be the rain

[Final Chorus: both voices, fuller, harmony on top]
You're a houseplant
Growing toward me
I don't deserve the way you stay
You're a houseplant
Still in the morning
I left you in the dark
And you grew anyway

[Outro: hum, guitar chord left ringing]
Ooh, you grew anyway
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 90 BPM, 4/4, D major. Slow, floating and sunlit. No sharp edges anywhere.

VOICE: Two men. The first has a light, high, sweet tenor with a little pitch-correction shimmer and a melodic, slurred delivery. The second has a deeper voice with a fast, wavering vibrato and a lazy, behind-the-beat feel. They sing the chorus together, the high voice on top.

INSTRUMENTS: Clean, chorus-effected electric guitar chords that ring and blur together. A soft, round 808 bass. A gentle, sparse beat with a muted kick and light hi-hats. Warm synth pads. A high, glassy synth melody in the chorus. Everything soaked in a soft reverb.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar chords and a hum. 0:11 Verse 1, the high voice. 0:32 Chorus 1, the beat enters. 0:59 Verse 2, the baritone. 1:23 Chorus 2. 1:50 Bridge, the beat drops out for the high voice and guitar. 2:09 Final chorus with a harmony on top. 2:36 Outro, a hum and one ringing chord, over by 2:45.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-2010s melodic hip-hop pop: hazy, warm and wide, vocals soft and tuned, low end deep but gentle.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The first chorus, when the two voices join and the beat arrives at 0:32.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The bridge is the new part. In the original the singers only admit their failings. Here one of them makes four small promises, which is what admitting it is for.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Fond guilt, admission, a small resolution.
